description.narrative: The most significant, expected project-level outcomes are the stakeholder effects on increased access to modern retail. The project is also expected to generate employee effects through quality job creation, and environmental effects through EDGE-certification of stores. Beyond the project outcomes, the IFC anticipates that its financing will promote greater market competitiveness via competitive pressure and capacity building channels. The project benefits from an inclusion adjustment due to expected increases in the female employee share in the workforce, and a climate adjustment.

The proposed IFC investment is an A-loan of up to US$15mn equivalent in Nigerian Naira (NGN), supported by IDA PSW Local Currency Facility (IDA PSW LCF). The proposed IFC loan is to support an expansion to open 25 new stores (the Project). Through its expansion plan, Justrite aims to become the leading supermarket retail brand in Nigeria.
